title: Wall 2 Fermat Prime Square Schur Defect and Arithmetic Progression Exclusion
description: We prove that on Fermat hypersurfaces, the prime-square Galois defect strictly exceeds one point five, preventing algebraic cycles from degenerating along infinite arithmetic progressions of Frobenius primes. We formalize this arithmetic progression exclusion in Lean 4 with zero sorry. In this work, ai is being used as a tool to assist in formal verification, symbol auditing, and manuscript preparation.
